content: The proven industry pattern (implemented by GitHub Copilot) for codebase-aware AI retrieval combines 3 core components: 1) Code Graph (AST + function call/import relationships) for cross-file code context understanding, 2) Code-specific embedding models (e.g. CodeBERT, UniXcoder) for semantic retrieval of relevant code snippets, 3) Workspace Memory for persistent storage of project/environment-level user preferences and static facts.
